reviews.author: Sean Y. Williams
reviews.text: Stanley Auto Repair is quite possibly the best auto shop I've been to. The staff there are proficient, able, and very friendly. I took my '92 Cutlass Ciera S in for some maintenance when my radiator and gaskets needed work. Would recommend to more people for great service and excellent quality.

reviews.author: MikeSuzy Rush
reviews.text: So happy to have found Stanley Auto Repair. Took my son's 94 Trans Am in for repair, Adam and his guys did a fantastic job. It drives like it did when it was new. It's been in the family since it was new... So the car is pretty special to our family, and when I picked it up, it was evident that Adam and crew put a lot of passion and pride into taking care of it for us! We will definitely return and recommend them to anyone looking for auto repair! Thanks again Adam and crew! The Rush family

reviews.author: MelissaJo Houser-Rhinehart
reviews.text: I can't say enough great things about Adam and his work. I've only had one other mechanic as talented as him. I found Adam by pure fate just like the last one I had. It was a Saturday afternoon, and he was the only one open. It's been over 10 years doing business with him, and everyone I have sent his way has thanked me over and over. He is a blessing as well as his staff. Most HONEST AND TRUSTWORTHY person I know, and he is priced perfectly. Thank you for being here in our area and for all the honest work you do.

reviews.author: Jerry and Patricia Kimmons
reviews.text: This guy knows his vehicles!!!! He is dedicated to doing his job well, and is FAIR, FAIR, FAIR!!! Rare in these times, I know, but we were so pleased with his explanation, execution, and price. Very quickly fixed our thermostat issue, and our heat is working great now and the car isn't running hot anymore! We had it at another place for over a week with promises to "look at it tomorrow." We took it to Stanley's, and the next day, we picked it up fixed up and running great!! Take your vehicle there!! You'll be so glad you did!

reviews.author: Lisa Parker
reviews.text: Adam was great! Quick service & a great price. Got my car in and out in a day when my usual place was backed up & would take 3-4 days to look at my car. Came well-suggested and I can see why!

reviews.author: Ellen Batton
reviews.text: Stanley Auto repaired my vehicle quickly, was fair priced and very polite. I recommend him to anyone. Thank you Stanley Auto.

reviews.author: Bo Salvucci
reviews.text: This man knows his stuff.He's a great mechanic.He doesn't overcharge you.I have nothing but good things to say about this guy and all the guys working with him !
